summary: Training deck on sample receipt and chain of custody, copied into the Brindlewythe QA training share. The receipt steps and custody record come from a deck prepared at Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc; the source footer is still on the receipt and storage slides, and the sample card routing has been rewritten for the group.

properties.subject: Sample receipt and chain of custody training
properties.keywords: sample receipt; chain of custody; sample card; QA training

slides.title: Sample receipt and chain of custody
slides.subtitle: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | QA training 2024
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
slides.notes: Required for new reception staff and the bench biologists from October. Sign the training record after the session.

slides.title: Why we check receipt first
bullets: Every test lot is checked against its paperwork at the door
The sample card is the record of what we were sent and in what state

bullets.text: A card with a missing field goes back to the sender before storage

bullets: Chain of custody starts at receipt, not at the bench
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Receipt steps
bullets: Check the courier label against the manifest
Open the package and note its condition
Match each vial to its sample card

bullets.text: Two people check any vial with a broken seal

bullets: Log the test lot in the receipt book and the sample system
Store at the stated temperature within the hour
slides.notes: Steps are unchanged from the original deck. The receipt book is the group one now, not the Merrivoss log.

slides.title: Chain of custody record

rows: Matches the vial label and the manifest
Name and initials of the receiving person
Seal intact, labels legible, temperature indicator
Freezer and shelf, entered at the time of storage
Each move between bench and store, with date and initials

slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Sample cards in our routing
bullets: Cards are filed by study code once the test lot is logged
The sample card travels with the vial on every transfer

bullets.text: Scan the card at each handover

bullets: Cards are returned to the study folder after the screen gate
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Storage and release
bullets: Vials go to the store only after the card is signed
Release to the bench needs the study code and the test lot number
Excursions are reported to the quality team the same day

slides.title: Discrepancies
bullets_right: Hold the vial and the card together
Call the sample management coordinator before moving anything
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Training record and questions
bullets: Complete the walk-through on a test lot with a supervisor
Sign the training record on the QA share
Questions to Ines Alvarado or Henning Flantz
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
